pairs.registryProposal: Pagination says a table with no window bound has decided to fail at some size, but it never exempts a closed catalog (one row per ad platform, or an authored mix of seven). A full .map is then both the right breakdown and the unbounded-table failure. Spell that a closed catalog or an aggregate whose cardinality is that catalog makes window mechanics not-applicable.
